name: review-command-supersession-signal
title: Superseded review commands carry no supersession signal in their peer adapters or frontmatter
description: sd-review/SKILL.md forbids calling sd-review-local and sd-review-pr; the sd-help catalog already marks both transitional-until-0.62.0, but the peer command adapters and skill frontmatter carry no supersession signal at the palette choice point. All files vendored: record a disposition and, if chosen, an upstream proposal via the vendored-artifact route; no local edits to provenance-tracked files. The disposition must also reconcile the expired 'transitional until 0.62.0' promise against installed pack version 0.64.3.
